'''Miohippus''' is an [[extinct]] species of [[horse]] from the [[wikipedia:Cenozoic|Cenozoic]] era, introduced in the [[Release_information/53.15|Dino Update]] along with other [[Creature#Extinct|prehistoric creatures]]. They are about the [[size]] of a [[goat]], being much smaller than present-day horses, too small to be ridden.

Miohippus can be [[milk]]ed when [[taming|tamed]], and are in fact the only prehistoric animal in the game that produces milk.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] miohippus for their ''small size'' and ''three toes''.
